producedBy: a coding agent acting as the development model (agent mode)

types.name: Recall
types.description: A manufacturer's recall notice posted to the recall exchange, with this distributor's effectiveness response once one is filed.

properties.name: recallNumber
properties.description: The exchange's recall number, e.g. RCL-26-0412.

properties.name: firm
properties.description: The manufacturer that issued the recall.

properties.name: product
properties.description: The recalled product: its name and its eleven-digit NDC.

properties.name: affectedLots
properties.description: Every lot the manufacturer recalled, by lot code and expiry, including lots this distributor never held.

properties.name: recallClass
properties.description: The recall's hazard class, CLASS_I (most serious) to CLASS_III.

properties.name: disclosure
properties.description: PUBLIC, or EMBARGOED while the notice is not yet public.

properties.name: lifecycle
properties.description: ACTIVE, or TERMINATED once the manufacturer ends the recall.

properties.name: issuedOn
properties.description: The day the notice was issued.

properties.name: responseStatus
properties.description: PENDING until this distributor's response is on file, then RECEIVED.

properties.name: response
properties.description: This distributor's effectiveness response, once filed.

sensitive.reason: The manufacturer's health hazard evaluation describes possible adverse health consequences of the product.

actions.name: FileRecallResponse
actions.description: Files this distributor's one effectiveness response to a notice: the lots it quarantined, their doses, the shipments still in transit and who signed it off.

findings.message: The exchange writes NDCs as eleven digits without hyphens (product.ndc11); any comparison with another system's NDC must normalise the format first.
affectedLots names lots by lotCode, which no entity in these sources is keyed by; whether it is another system's lot number is for a reviewer to settle.
An EMBARGOED notice is visible to the distributor client and not to the viewer client: who inside the business may read it is a policy decision the evidence does not make.
